  106 #===============================================================================
  107 # Decreases the target's Attack by 1 stage. Heals user by an amount equal to the
  108 # target's Attack stat (after applying stat stages, before this move decreases
  109 # it). (Strength Sap)
  110 #===============================================================================
  111 class Battle::Move::HealUserByTargetAttackLowerTargetAttack1 < Battle::Move
  112   attr_reader :statDown
  113 
  114   def initialize(battle, move)
  115     super
  116     @statDown = [:ATTACK, 1]
  117   end
  118 
  119   def healingMove?;  return true; end
  120   def canMagicCoat?; return true; end
  121 
  122   def pbFailsAgainstTarget?(user, target, show_message)
  123     # NOTE: The official games appear to just check whether the target's Attack
  124     #       stat stage is -6 and fail if so, but I've added the "fail if target
  125     #       has Contrary and is at +6" check too for symmetry. This move still
  126     #       works even if the stat stage cannot be changed due to an ability or
  127     #       other effect.
  128     if !@battle.moldBreaker && target.hasActiveAbility?(:CONTRARY)
  129       if target.statStageAtMax?(@statDown[0])
  130         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!")) if show_message
  131         return true
  132       end
  133     elsif target.statStageAtMin?(@statDown[0])
  134       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!")) if show_message
  135       return true
  136     end
  137     return false
  138   end
  139 
  140   def pbEffectAgainstTarget(user, target)
  141     # Calculate target's effective attack value
  142     max_stage = Battle::Battler::STAT_STAGE_MAXIMUM
  143     stageMul = Battle::Battler::STAT_STAGE_MULTIPLIERS
  144     stageDiv = Battle::Battler::STAT_STAGE_DIVISORS
  145     atk      = target.attack
  146     atkStage = target.stages[@statDown[0]] + max_stage
  147     healAmt = (atk.to_f * stageMul[atkStage] / stageDiv[atkStage]).floor
  148     # Reduce target's Attack stat
  149     if target.pbCanLowerStatStage?(@statDown[0], user, self)
  150       target.pbLowerStatStage(@statDown[0], @statDown[1], user)
  151     end
  152     # Heal user
  153     if target.hasActiveAbility?(:LIQUIDOOZE, true)
  154       @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(target)
  155       user.pbReduceHP(healAmt)
  156       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} sucked up the liquid ooze!", user.pbThis))
  157       @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(target)
  158       user.pbItemHPHealCheck
  159     elsif user.canHeal?
  160       healAmt = (healAmt * 1.3).floor if user.hasActiveItem?(:BIGROOT)
  161       user.pbRecoverHP(healAmt)
  162       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s HP was restored.", user.pbThis))
  163     end
  164   end
  165 end

  239 #===============================================================================
  240 # The user and its allies gain 25% of their total HP and are cured of their
  241 # permanent status problems. (Jungle Healing)
  242 #===============================================================================
  243 class Battle::Move::HealUserAndAlliesQuarterOfTotalHPCureStatus < Battle::Move
  244   def healingMove?; return true; end
  245 
  246   def pbMoveFailed?(user, targets)
  247     if @battle.allSameSideBattlers(user).none? { |b| b.canHeal? || b.status != :NONE }
  248       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!"))
  249       return true
  250     end
  251     return false
  252   end
  253 
  254   def pbFailsAgainstTarget?(user, target, show_message)
  255     return target.status == :NONE && !target.canHeal?
  256   end
  257 
  258   def pbEffectAgainstTarget(user, target)
  259     if target.canHeal?
  260       target.pbRecoverHP(target.totalhp / 4)
  261       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s HP was restored.", target.pbThis))
  262     end
  263     if target.status != :NONE
  264       old_status = target.status
  265       target.pbCureStatus(false)
  266       case old_status
  267       when :SLEEP
  268         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} was woken from sleep.", target.pbThis))
  269       when :POISON
  270         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} was cured of its poisoning.", target.pbThis))
  271       when :BURN
  272         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s burn was healed.", target.pbThis))
  273       when :PARALYSIS
  274         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} was cured of paralysis.", target.pbThis))
  275       when :FROZEN
  276         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} was thawed out.", target.pbThis))
  277       end
  278     end
  279   end
  280 end

  465 #===============================================================================
  466 # Damages user by 1/2 of its max HP, even if this move misses. (Mind Blown)
  467 #===============================================================================

  469   def worksWithNoTargets?; return true; end
  470 
  471   def pbMoveFailed?(user, targets)
  472     if !@battle.moldBreaker
  473       bearer = @battle.pbCheckGlobalAbility(:DAMP)
  474       if bearer
  475         @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(bearer)
  476         if Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
  477           @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} cannot use {2}!", user.pbThis, @name))
  478         else

  482         @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(bearer)
  483         return true
  484       end
  485     end

  487   end

  491     user.pbReduceHP((user.totalhp / 2.0).round, false)
